detail: Metadata now matches both buffered RC stages; reconstruction offset remains zero.
Missing BUSY interrupts fail the diagnostic rather than waiting indefinitely.
Timer suppresses later triggers until restart.
Logging is outside measurement windows; IMU FIFO service uses a separate task.
Recorder waits up to 100ms for first interrupt before draining FIFO.
Native model test checks exact byte consumption.

CLI executes actual diagnostic firmware; seven scenarios pass after startup SPI initialization and shared diagnostic fault-latch corrections. Browser contention warning alone did not establish failure. Physical checks remain pending.
Received board straps, logic levels, reference, supply/noise/timing/SD/Wi-Fi/runtime remain unmeasured.
Establish mode-2 SPI with a discarded reset-time read before conversion triggers; first counted frame now has expected codes. Received chip startup still requires bench scope verification.
Shared atomic fault latch prevents main diagnostic task from reporting further windows after IMU worker fault.
Verifier checks the foot sensor selected by scenario configuration; regression test protects role mapping.
Workers suspend after completion; owner joins, waits for suspended states, deletes and clears handles. Fault latch stops acquisition. Native early-completion case passes.
Both IMU stops are attempted even if foot stop fails; sensor fault remains visible.
Wireless END follows final write/sync/close checks. Failure emits storage reason 1. SD END alone cannot certify persistence after a late filesystem error.

Production ADC task now wakes directly from the conversion timer callback on core 1 and bounds BUSY polling to 80 us. Previous BUSY IRQ delay violated the 125 us slot in integrated execution; fault evidence is preserved.
Anchor each IMU clock once, then advance by FIFO timestamp deltas; nominal integrated exports have zero timestamp regressions. Estimated time, drift and startup alignment remain uncalibrated.
An interrupt during a read marks timing uncertainty; it no longer alone creates a sample-gap claim. Counter deltas and missing data remain explicit.
Actual UDP code collects short batches with a 2 ms target to reduce packet traffic. Delivery and END remain best-effort; packets/records can be dropped without corrupting SD.
Packet-loss fixture discarded END. Receiver correctly reports ended=false and unknown stop reason; corrected assertion no longer requires delivery or invents an END.
Four cases were refused by monthly CI quota. Low-battery export and nominal trace capture are incomplete; full matrix pass remains false.

v1.6 requires BUSY high after the 1 us CONVST pulse. Previously missing/disconnected BUSY or ignored CONVST could accept plausible stale ADC words. Sixteen native ADC groups and six native pipeline groups pass; full v1.6 integrated 18-case cloud execution remains pending.
